meta.data_description_zh:
1. 台灣地區人工生殖資料庫於民國 87 年建立，由各人工生殖機構定期通報期間內
於其機構接受人工生殖（但不含配偶間的人工授精）之個案資料。
2. 人工生殖資料通報及管理辦法依人工生殖法第二十七條第二項規定訂定之。
3. 「人工生殖資料通報辦法」中華民國九十六年八月八日行政院衛生署署授國字第
0960400731 號令訂定發布全文 15 條；並自發布日施行。
4. 人工生殖機構應通報之人工生殖資料如下：
一、生殖細胞捐贈人健康檢查及評估。
二、捐贈生殖細胞施術結果。
三、捐贈生殖細胞或以捐贈之生殖細胞形成之胚胎未完成捐贈、返還、銷毀、 轉贈
或轉移之資料。
四、人工生殖開始使用排卵藥物等進入治療週期個案之資料。
五、人工生殖個案資料。
六、受術夫妻生殖細胞或胚胎銷毀資料
5. 開始使用藥物年度包含民國87年至112 年。
meta.notes_zh:
1. 未控管不孕期間之資料填寫，未來通報時會檢查不孕期間不大於受術妻年齡。
2. 新生兒相關資訊為0者，表示沒有新生兒資料。
3. 人工生殖資料通報及管理辦法於 96 年施行後，因需與其他資料庫鏈接，故將編
碼改版，96年以前舊資料也依新版編碼轉換。惟部分編碼因格式或新版編碼之闕
漏，會產生亂碼或不明之編碼。
4. 其他資料可參考：國民健康署-人工生殖資料通報及管理辦法。
※本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身分證
字號、院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日期等欄位
均經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜出經審核通過
之統計結果，以確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。
meta.data_description_en: 1. This database is de-identified: directly identifying fields such as name and address are removed, and ID number, facility code, insurer-unit code, tax ID, birth date, visit date, and admission date are masked; data may only be used on-site and only approved aggregate results exported, ensuring individuals cannot be re-identified. 2. The ID numbers of the victim and respondent may be blank. 3. If a victim has multiple disability conditions, they are recorded in the same field (victim disability type). 4. Date fields use the ROC calendar; 000/00/00 means unknown — e.g. 0000101 = year unknown, 1040001 = month unknown, 1040100 = day unknown. 5. The respondent data is the primary respondent's data. 1. The victim record-grouping/matching key is ID_C. 2. The respondent record-grouping/matching key is ID_D.
meta.notes_en: Recorded from 2002. 1: Well differentiated; Differentiated, NOS; 2: Moderately differentiated; Moderately well differentiated; Intermediate differentiated; 3: Poorly differentiated; 4: Undifferentiated; Anaplastic; 9: Grade or differentiation not determined, not stated, or not applicable. Note: because tumor grade/differentiation uses 2-, 3-, or 4-tier schemes for different cancers, see the pre-ROC-100 Taiwan Cancer Registry long/short-form abstracting manuals for details.

meta.data_description_en: 1. Note: This center's databases are de-identified (fields masked as above); data may only be used on-site and only approved aggregate results exported, ensuring individuals cannot be re-identified. 2. Contains raw data for cases diagnosed 2007-2010 as reported by each hospital, without removing inter-hospital duplicate cases (same person, same cancer, same histology group). 3. The cancers covered by the cancer-registry short form include, besides all cancers reported by short-form hospitals, all other cancers not reported by long-form hospitals — all reported via the short form. 4. To analyze data grouped and de-duplicated across hospitals from diagnosis year 1979 to the latest published year, apply for the annual-report grouped file. 1. ID number is encrypted. 2. The person-grouping/matching key is ID.
meta.notes_en:
1. This center's database has been de-identified: directly identifying fields such as name and address have been removed, and fields such as ID number, facility code, insured unit code, tax ID number, date of birth, visit date, and admission date have been masked. The data may only be used within the independent workspace established by the Ministry, and only approved aggregate statistical results may be taken out, ensuring that the data and its disclosure method can no longer identify specific individuals.
2. The infertility-duration field was not validated at the time of entry; going forward, notifications will check that the infertility duration does not exceed the age of the wife undergoing treatment.
3. A value of 0 in the newborn-related information fields indicates that there is no newborn data.
4. After the Assisted Reproduction Data Reporting and Management Regulations took effect in 2007 (ROC year 96), the coding scheme was revised because linkage with other databases was required; data prior to 2007 was also converted to the new coding scheme. However, for some codes, due to format issues or gaps in the new coding scheme, garbled or unrecognized codes may appear.
5. For further information, see: Health Promotion Administration - Assisted Reproduction Data Reporting and Management Regulations.
